content.text: Lunghringnae awm laipalah
nangmanaw nahoehmaw tami lungkaangnaw lah na kaawm awh heh,
namamouh hoi lungangnae teh rei a due han.
Hateiteh, nangmouh patetlah panuethainae ka tawn van.
Nangmouh hlak vah hoe ka rahnoum hoeh.
Het patet e hno panue hoeh e apimaw kaawm.
Kai teh, huikonaw ni panuikhaie lah ka o teh,
Cathut a kaw teh, ama ni a pathung e kai heh,
tamikalan, toun han awmhoeh,
a panuikhaie kâhmo e lah ka o.
Kanawmcalah kaawmnaw e khopouknae dawkvah,
yawthoenae heh panuikhainae lah ao teh,
a kamthui nahanlah coungkacoe paloung pouh e lah ao.
Dingcanaw e rim law teh a hmacawn teh,
Cathut lungkhueksakkungnaw law teh a roum awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh Cathut ni a kut hoi a kawkhik.
Hateiteh, atu moithangnaw koe pacei nateh, na cangkhai awh han doeh.
Kalvan e kamleng e tavanaw hai pacei haw, na dei pouh han doeh.
Hoeh pawiteh, talai koe vah dei pouh haw, na cangkhai han doeh,
Talî dawk e tanganaw ni nangmouh teh
kamcengcalah na panue sak han doeh.
Hete hnonaw dawk BAWIPA ni a sak tie hah,
ka panuek hoeh e nangmouh thung dawk apimaw kaawm.
A kut dawk hringnae katawnnaw puenghoi,
tami pueng e kâhanae ao.
Kâko ni rawca a patek e patetlah
hnâ ni lawk hah a tanouk nahoehmaw.
Kacuenaw koe lungangnae ao teh,
a kumcue torei teh, panuethainae ao.
Ahni koe lungangnae hoi thaonae ao.
Ahni ni khokhangnae hoi panuethainae a tawn.
Hno heh raphoe hnukkhu hoi teh, bout sak thai hoeh toe,
tami khak paung hoi teh tâco thai nahan a ru toe.
Tui hah pahak hoi teh a ke toe,
tui bout tha torei teh talai dawk bout a kamuem.
Ama koe thasainae hoi roumnae a onae hoi
ka payonsakkung teh amae doeh.
Khokhangkungnaw hah be kahma lah a ceikhai teh,
lawkcengkung hah be a pathu sak.
Siangpahrangnaw kateknae hah a rathap pouh teh,
a kengnaw dawk taisawm a kâyeng sak awh.
Bawinaw hah takcaici lah a hrawi teh,
athakaawme taminaw hah a rawp sak.
A kâuepkhai awh e lawknaw hah a hnoun pouh teh,
kacuenaw e panuethainae hah a takhoe pouh awh.
Bawinaw lathueng vah dudamnae a rabawk teh,
tami tha kaawm naw hah kutcaici lah ao sak.
Hmonae thung hoi kadung poung e hno koung a kamnue sak,
Duenae tâhlip hah angnae dawk a tâcokhai,
Miphunnaw hah a len sak teh bout a raphoe.
Miphunnaw hah a kâthap sak teh bout a hrawi.
Talai e tamihu kahrawinaw hah panuethainae naw a kahma sak teh,
kahrawngum lamthung a ohoehnae koe a kâva sak.
Angnae awm laipalah hmonae thung thupthup a payam awh,
ka parui e tami patetlah rawraw a cu sak.
